host_enum_test_ids.source: HAL .data.rel.ro table fpc_sensortest_tests @0x27940, 13 entries x 48 bytes {u32 id, pad, char* name @+8, char* description @+0x10, char* stamp @+0x18}, names recovered from .rela.dyn; consumed by HAL get_sensor_tests 0x1b098..0x1b1d8 (loop bound 0x270/0x30 = 13, calls fpc_tee_sensortest_is_test_supported per entry)

entries.name: Self Test
entries.description: Tests the sensor response and interrupt signal

entries.name: Checkerboard Test
entries.description: Takes an sensor internal image and analyze to find dead pixels

entries.name: Image Quality Test
entries.description: Takes an image with square pattern stamp and analyze to find coating issues

entries.name: Image Reset Pixel Test
entries.description: Takes an sensor internal image and analyze to find faulty pixels

entries.name: AFD Cal Test
entries.description: Validates analog finger detection function of sensor module.

entries.name: Module Quality Test
entries.description: Takes an image with zebra pattern stamp and determine the SNR (signal to noise ratio) value

entries.name: Defective Pixels Test
entries.description: Verifies that the number of pixel errors or dead pixels are within limits

entries.name: OTP Validation Test
entries.description: Checks the OTP memory for manufacturing defects and the wafer contains relevant information

entries.name: TXPulse Checkerboard Test
entries.description: Takes an sensor internal image and analyze to find dead pixels (TXPULSE)

entries.name: ESD Check Pre Test
entries.description: Read all of the RW registers and store those

entries.name: ESD Check Test
entries.description: Verifies latch up or bit-shift of sensor internal status and must run ESD Check Pre first

entries.name: ESD Check Post Test
entries.description: If ESD test fail and resume by reset the sensor and download the registers dumped before

0x203dc r = fpc_tee_status_irq(ctx): r<0 -> log 'IRQ TEST READ AFTER -> FPC_ERROR_SENSOR' (0xd176) -> return 7 ; r==0 -> repeat 0x20350 ; r>0 -> fpc_tee_sensortest_test_command(ctx, 2, &buf+0x2c) i.e. cmd2 cleanup [0x203f8]; on error log 'FPC_TA_SENSORTEST_SELF_TEST_CLEANUP failed' (0xb343) -> return 7

factory_util.note: The utility statically embeds its own copies of the same HAL functions. Addresses inside fpc_tee_test are different from the HAL .so but the code is instruction-for-instruction equivalent for run_test/capture/test_command (same constants, same 1->7 rewrite).

cli.long_opts: 0xd5c0, 12 entries of 32 bytes {name, has_arg@+8, flag@+0x10, val@+0x18} (relocated pointers read from .rela.dyn)
cli.unknown_options: -h, -V, -r, -R and anything else land on the default arm 0x54c8 -> "Non handled option '%c'. Close down" (0x33fe)

prints printf('%s: %d', 'capture_uncalibrated', status) at 0x5550..0x5564 and then 'End of test.'

notes: run_test is always called with delay_ms = 0 except -q (500 ms) — 0x51c0 mov w2,#0x1f4.
The 28-byte parameter block passed to run_test is zero-initialised by the utility for every option (e.g. 0x518c-0x51a8, 0x52ec-0x5314), i.e. the factory tool uses default test settings.
After each sensortest call the utility prints printf('%s: %d', <test name>, status_from_buf+0x2c) (format 0x3013, e.g. 0x531c/0x5324) — the value printed is the TA's +0x2c field, not the return code.

No image file is written anywhere by this tool: there is no .pgm/.raw/.bmp/.png string and the -u block only prints the status. File outputs that do exist are the template DB ('/data/system/test.db', '%s Successfully wrote template database %s'), db blobs, and KPI CSVs written as '%s/oddc_%s%s_%04d%02d%02d%02d%02d%02d_%s_#%s#.csv' under '/data/fpc/diag_logs' (0x2d3f, 0x38d8, 0x38ad). 'img.id' (0x25f8) is a CSV column label (fprintf arg at 0x8254), not a file name.

enroll_no_sensor / authentication_no_sensor are not module-5 commands: 0x55d8 opens a directory (0x5638 opendir) and the injected-image path uses fpc_tee_debug_inject ('fpc_tee_debug_inject' referenced at 0x7410) with the enroll/verify directories ('/data/system/enroll/', '/data/system/verify/'). Fully reversing 0x55d8/0x5a10 was out of scope (it is the enrol/identify flow, not module 5).

TAC-layer meaning of the length passed to the handler (fpc_tac_transfer 0x22df0 puts [shared+0x10] into the QSEECom descriptor; the QSEECom 0x40/0x40 sizes are constant for every transfer).

Image geometry/format of the uncalibrated capture (lives behind sensor_driver_capture_image 0x16764 / fpc_sensor_driver_get_default_capture_config 0x17a70; nothing in module 5 carries it).
